name: Sofia Giovanni
source: Sofia is grumpy and distrustful. She doesn't trust anyone and is disliked by people. Sofia is a natural witch, able to cast curses and spells. Sofia avoids creating close relationships with people, on the other hand, people avoid doing it with her. Sofia is intelligent but prejudiced, she always sees the worst in people and is suspicious of everything they say.
